page.layout: One page of text, verse. Running head top left, page number top right. Continuing verse (end of a Psalm paragraph from the previous page), then the author's initials, then a rule, then the heading "PSALMVS XCI." and a new paragraph of verse. No margin notes. Gathering signature at foot.

l.i: Fer nominis te dulce decus tui
Dicant, eorum nunc vbi nunc Deus?
Rex, exprobrarunt quod tibi, quod tuis,
At nos ouilis grex humilis tui,

main_text.l: Felix ô multum felix, qui rebus in

l.i: arcem Confugit æternum. Meus es, Deus optime, custos,
Inquier, arx, statio, & non labile fundamentum.

page.notes: No marginal notes. The large initial F of "Felix" is joined to the first word. The rule above the Psalm heading is an ornament and is not transcribed. "Inquier" is uncertain (may be Inquies) and should be checked against the scan. The signature "Q. iiij." at the foot looks handwritten and may be a later annotation rather than a printed gathering mark. Faint show-through text from the reverse side appears in the right margin and at the lower left ("Per"); it is not transcribed. The short mark near the page number is not printed text.
